title: Dayton, OH — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Dayton, OH: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Dayton is a city in OH with a population of 137,000. Birthplace of aviation with Wright-Patterson AFB, the Air Force Museum, and innovation heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.2.
